[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Make the commit declaration an authoring step, not a consent vote[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The finalizer declaration asks an agent only to author commit [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]messages. Leaving a tree dirty becomes a rare, typed, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]host-adjudicated deferral that is corrected while the agent is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]still alive and never destroys a run.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Typed deferral and a non-failing refusal policy in Rust core[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core: add the typed deferral-reason enum, the `defer` refusal policy, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the non-failing Deferred statuses to the Rust finalizer wire, then [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]release the crate.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Adopt the released core floor and the deferral config schema[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]adopt[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]adopt: raise the sase_core_rs floor, mirror the new wire records in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase.core.finalizer_wire, and accept `refusal: fail | defer` in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]finalizer config.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Adjudicate deferrals at submit time instead of after the turn[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]adjudicate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after adopt[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]adjudicate: replace the free-text `refuse` action with typed `defer` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]decisions and make `sase final submit` reject unfounded deferrals as [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]repairable validation errors while the agent still holds its context.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]A deliberate deferral escape hatch that does not fail the run[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]escape[dim] · [dim][/dim]after adjudicate[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]escape: add `sase final defer`, honor `refusal: defer` in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]controller, and report a deferred turn as a completed run with a dirty [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tree that the user is told about, instead of a FAILED run with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stranded workspace.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Publish the commit consent model where agents actually read it[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]consent[dim] · [dim][/dim]after adjudicate[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]consent: carry the commit-by-default rule and per-repository provenance [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]evidence in `sase final context` output, rewrite the `/sase_final` skill[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]around authoring, and remove the self-contradiction in the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]declaration-recovery prompt.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Historical regression corpus, live acceptance, telemetry, and [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]docs[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]acceptance[dim] · [dim][/dim]after escape, consent[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]acceptance: replay every historical refusal as a regression fixture, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prove the protocol live end to end, add refusal and deferral telemetry, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and synchronize the finalizer documentation.[/#D7D7AF]
